# Full-bleed Hero

`hero/full-bleed` &middot; section-level &middot; category: hero

## Purpose

Large background image with a centered heading, subheading and button on top.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `subheading` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |
| `image` | url |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered text over the image.
- **compact**: Shorter hero for secondary announcements. Sets `height: 220px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `height` | length | `"320px"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `headingLevel` | one of `display`, `h1`, `h2` | `"h1"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background image uses a VML fallback. | Background images can be cropped or blocked, keep the message in text. | Keeps its own colors on purpose. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('hero/full-bleed', {
  "heading": "Summer Collection",
  "subheading": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days.",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
  },
  "image": "https://placehold.co/1200x640/png?text=HERO"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "hero/full-bleed",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Summer Collection",
    "subheading": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days.",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop the collection",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
    },
    "image": "https://placehold.co/1200x640/png?text=HERO"
  }
}
```
